I have farmed this land for many years, so I know the soil is tired and needs manure from my cattle and some urea from the agro-dealer to give a good maize harvest. I will plant improved seed because it survives better when the rains in Manyara come late or stop early, which happens often now. My wife and children will do most of the weeding and harvesting, but I will hire a few young men from the village to help with planting and shelling because 1.69 hectares is more than my family can manage alone.
